alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148529
alerts.description: Between Exit 129: Bair Ranch (6 miles west of the Dotsero area) and Exit 125: Hanging Lake (5 miles east of the No Name area) from Mile Point 126 to Mile Point 125. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 23, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 23, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 23, 7:00AM - October 23, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
